topic: Giving the Landlord a One-Month Move-Out Notice

script.title: THE MOVE-OUT NOTICE
script.scene_zh: 管理辦公室 · 告知退租
script.story_hook: A verbal heads-up, but the office wants ink.
script.intro_zh: 口頭說了不算，辦公室要的是白紙黑字。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back to today's leasing office. Listen for move-out and deposit phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的管理辦公室。留意退租與押金的說法。
script.outro: Notice signed, dates clear, money sorted. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 通知簽好了，日期清楚了，錢也談定了。再聽一遍，跟著一起說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a slim young man in his early twenties with sandy hair in a messy side part, light freckles, an olive green flannel shirt over a grey tee, a canvas tote bag on one shoulder, and an easygoing posture
script.char_b_description: a no-nonsense woman in her forties with shoulder-length straight dark hair, rectangular glasses, a charcoal blazer over a white blouse, an ID lanyard at her chest, and a tall straight-backed build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, um, I'm giving notice? Moving out, kinda.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ʌm aɪm ˈɡɪvɪŋ ˈnoʊtəs muːvɪŋ aʊt ˈkɑɪndə/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，呃，我來告知一聲，我要搬家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, how soon are you thinking?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ haʊ sun ɑɹ ju θɪŋkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，你計畫多快搬？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One month from today, if that works.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mʌnθ fɹəm təˈdeɪ ɪf ðæt wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 從今天算一個月，如果來得及的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can, but I need it in writing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kən bʌt aɪ nid ɪt ɪn ˈɹaɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但我需要白紙黑字的書面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Writing? I just, um, told you out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹaɪtɪŋ aɪ dʒʌst ʌm toʊld ju aʊt ˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 書面？我剛剛，嗯，已經當面說了呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, true, but office rules, a signed form.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɹu bʌt ˈɔfəs ɹulz ə saɪnd fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 哈，也是，但辦公室規定，要簽過的表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. What does the form ask for?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ wʌt dʌz ðə fɔɹm æsk fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 合理。表格要填哪些欄位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name, unit number, move-out date, new address.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm ˈjuːnɪt ˈnʌmbɚ muːv aʊt deɪt nju əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 姓名、房號、搬出日期、新地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New address? I'm, well, staying at my aunt's.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju əˈdɹɛs aɪm wɛl steɪɪŋ æt maɪ ˈænts/
dialogue.zh: 新地址？我，呃，會先住到阿姨家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's an address, write it down for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ən əˈdɹɛs ɹaɪt ɪt daʊn fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 那也是地址，請幫我寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Unit twelve B, that's the one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈjuːnɪt twɛlz bi ðæts ði wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好。十二B，就是那一戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the date — when exactly do you leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə deɪt wɛn ɪɡˈzæktli du ju liv/
dialogue.zh: 日期那一欄——你確切哪天搬走？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: August? Um, the thirtieth, after my shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɡəst ʌm ðə ˈθɜɹti ˈæftɚ maɪ ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 八月？嗯，三十號，我下班之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's a catch: that's one day short.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ə kætʃ ðæts wʌn deɪ ʃɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有個問題：那天差了一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One day short? Explain that one for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ ʃɔɹt ɪkˈspleɪn ðæt wʌn fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 差一天？這怎麼說？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Notice counts from the first, so check the math.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtəs kaʊnts fɹəm ðə fɝːst soʊ tʃɛk ðə mæθ/
dialogue.zh: 通知期從月初一號算起，你算算看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the first of next month… plus a month?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ði fɝːst əv nɛkst mʌnθ plʌs ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 也就是下個月一號……再滿一個月？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'd stay through the thirty-first, that's the month.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊd steɪ θɹu ðə ˈθɜɹti fɝːst ðæts ðə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 住到三十一號，才剛好算滿一個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! Okay, the thirty-first, that's easier.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ oʊˈkeɪ ðə ˈθɜɹti fɝːst ðæts ˈizɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢！好，三十一號，這樣更簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll fix the form, nothing's ruined here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl fɪks ðə fɔɹm ˈnʌθɪŋz ɹuːɪnd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我幫你改表格，沒有關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Now money talk, can I ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks naʊ ˈmʌni tɔk kən aɪ æsk/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。接下來談錢，可以問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, that's my favorite part, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd ðæts maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt pɑɹt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 請問，這是我最喜歡的環節，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My deposit covers the last month, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dɪˈpɑzɪt ˈkʌvɚz ðə læst mʌnθ ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我的押金可以抵最後一個月的租金吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, common guess, but no, it doesn't.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ˈkɑmən ɡɛs bʌt noʊ ɪt dʌzənt/
dialogue.zh: 啊，很多人都這樣猜，但不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the deposit isn't rent?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə dɪˈpɑzɪt ˈɪzənt ɹɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 所以押金不是房租？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. Rent runs to the last day, in full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ɹɛnt ɹʌnz tə ðə læst deɪ ɪn fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 對。租金要付到最後一天，全額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oof. Okay, I'll pay it, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊf oʊˈkeɪ aɪl peɪ ɪt noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 唉。好，我會照付，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The deposit comes back if all is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɪˈpɑzɪt kʌmz bæk ɪf ɔl ɪz klɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 只要退房時一切清楚，押金會退回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's 'all is clear'? Walk me through it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ɔl ɪz klɪɹ wɑk mi θɹu ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 「一切清楚」是什麼意思？帶我走一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean unit, no damage, all keys returned.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ˈjuːnɪt noʊ ˈdæmɪdʒ ɔl kiz ɹɪˈtɝnd/
dialogue.zh: 房子乾淨、沒有損壞、鑰匙全數歸還。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My walls have, um, poster holes. Small ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ wɔlz hæv ʌm ˈpoʊstɚ hoʊlz smɔl wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 我的牆上有，呃，海報釘的小洞。小小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small holes are fine, we patch them cheaply.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl hoʊlz ɑɹ faɪn wi pætʃ ðəm ˈtʃipli/
dialogue.zh: 小洞沒關係，我們補起來很便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relief. What about the trash and everything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈlif wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə tɹæʃ ænd ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 鬆口氣。那垃圾和那些東西呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trash haul-off is forty, or take it yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹæʃ hɔl ɑf ɪz ˈfɔɹti ɔɹ teɪk ɪt jɔɹˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 垃圾清運四十塊，或者你自己清掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll haul it, my truck fits the whole load.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl hɔl ɪt maɪ tɹæk fɪts ðə hoʊl loʊd/
dialogue.zh: 我自己清，我的貨車裝得下全部。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. There's also the final walk-through.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ðɛɹz ˈɔlsoʊ ðə ˈfaɪnəl wɑk θɹu/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。還有一關：最後的交房檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk-through? Who's walking, and when?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑk θɹu wuz ˈwɔkɪŋ ænd wɛn/
dialogue.zh: 交房檢查？誰跟誰檢查，什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just me and you, moving day, we check the unit.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst mi ænd ju ˈmuːvɪŋ deɪ wi tʃɛk ði ˈjuːnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我跟你，搬那天，一起看房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you tell me right there if it's good?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju tɛl mi ɹaɪt ðɛɹ ɪf ɪts ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那你當場告訴我檢查過不過？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hand you a checklist, you watch it happen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hænd ju ə ˈtʃɛkˌlɪst ju wɑtʃ ɪt ˈhæpən/
dialogue.zh: 我會給你一張清單，你看著我們核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. How fast does the check come?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs haʊ fæst dʌz ðə tʃɛk kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。那押金支票多久會寄到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By law here, twenty-one days after you're out.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ lɔ hɪɹ ˈtwɛnti wʌn deɪz ˈæftɚ jʊɹ ˈaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 依這裡的規定，你搬走後二十一天內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty-one. Can they mail it to my aunt's?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti wʌn kən ðeɪ meɪl ɪt tə maɪ ˈænts/
dialogue.zh: 二十一天。可以寄到阿姨家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the forwarding address on the form covers that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈfɔɹˌwɜɹdɪŋ əˈdɹɛs ɑn ðə fɔɹm ˈkʌvɚz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，表格上的轉寄地址就是這個用途。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I update it later, is that cool?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf aɪ ˈʌpˌdeɪt ɪt ˈleɪɾɚ ɪz ðæt kul/
dialogue.zh: 之後如果要改地址，還可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just email me, I can redirect before it goes out.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈimeɪl mi aɪ kən ˌri dəˈrɛkt bɪˈfɔɹ ɪt ɡoʊz aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 寄封郵件給我，在支票寄出前都能改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. One last thing, the parking remote?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝːfɪkt wʌn læst θɪŋ ðə ˈpɑɹkɪŋ ɹɪˈmoʊt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。最後一件，停車遙控器呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Return it with the keys, it's fifty otherwise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈtɝn ɪt wɪð ðə kiz ɪts ˈfɪfti ˈʌðɚˌwaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 要跟鑰匙一起歸還，不然扣五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty! It's on the fridge hook, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ɪts ɑn ðə fɹɪdʒ hʊk aɪ ˈpɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 五十！它就在冰箱那個鉤子上，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I believe you. Form signed, all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ bɪˈliv ju fɔɹm saɪnd ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我信你。表格簽好了，全部搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This felt easy, honestly. I was nervous.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fɛlt ˈizi ˈɑnəstli aɪ wəz ˈnɝvəs/
dialogue.zh: 這比我想的輕鬆，老實說，我剛剛還緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Notices are easy when you ask good questions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtəsəz ɑɹ ˈizi wɛn ju æsk ɡʊd ˈkwɛstʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 願意問好問題，退租通知就不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ask twice as many at my next move.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æsk twaɪs æz ˈmɛni æt maɪ nɛkst muːv/
dialogue.zh: 下次搬家，我會問兩倍的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's a copy for you, highlight the dates.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ə ˈkɑpi fɚ ju ˈhaɪˌlaɪt ðə deɪts/
dialogue.zh: 這張副本給你，把日期劃上記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Highlighted, photographed, fridge magnet, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhaɪˌlaɪtəd ˈfoʊtoʊɡræft fɹɪdʒ ˈmæɡnɪt dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 記號畫好、拍照、貼上冰箱，完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your truck fits the loading zone, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ tɹæk fɪts ðə ˈloʊdɪŋ zoʊn ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你的貨車停在裝貨區，位置夠吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It does, um, see you that evening!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz ʌm si ju ðæt ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 夠的，嗯，那天傍晚見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me if anything changes before then.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi ɪf ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ˈtʃeɪndʒəz bɪˈfɔɹ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 在那之前有變動，傳簡訊給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Thanks for the patience, really.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du θæŋks fɚ ðə ˈpeɪʃənz ˈɹiəli/
dialogue.zh: 會的。真的謝謝你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good luck at your aunt's, bye for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd lʊk æt jɔɹ ˈænts baɪ fɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 祝你在阿姨家順利，先再見囉。

script.youtube_title: 【退租要提前一個月📦】「所以押金不是房租？」😳表格怎麼填・鑰匙怎麼還🔑｜聽完自己辦退租｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Giving a Move-Out Notice
script.youtube_title_en: "So the Deposit Isn't Rent?" — Giving a One-Month Move-Out Notice
script.youtube_description:
「所以押金不是房租？」——去辦公室口頭說了搬家，為什麼還不算數？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在公寓的管理辦公室。

你會聽到：口頭通知為什麼要補成簽名的書面表格；通知期從當月起算、日期差一天怎麼修正；押金不能抵扣最後一個月租金的規矩、押金退回來的三個條件；垃圾清運與停車遙控器的扣款、交房檢查清單、二十一天寄支票與轉寄地址的完整流程。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人辦事情的自然語感：um、kinda、well、ha、honestly。聽完你就會用：I'm giving notice、I need it in writing、Walk me through it、See you that evening。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"So the deposit isn't rent?" — telling your landlord out loud just started the paperwork. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in the leasing office on notice day.

You will hear: why a verbal heads-up needs a signed form; how the notice month counts from the first and how a one-day date slip gets fixed; why the deposit never covers the last month's rent, and the three conditions to get it back; trash haul-off fees, the parking remote penalty, the final walk-through checklist, and mailing the check to your forwarding address in twenty-one days.

Everything stays in A2-level words with real office-side rhythm: um, kinda, well, ha, honestly. By the end you'll own phrases like I'm giving notice, Walk me through it, and Text me if anything changes.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
跟管理處說了一聲要搬家，就以為搞定了嗎？押金能不能抵最後一個月的房租？退房時要乾淨到什麼程度，支票才會快點寄來？

這一集帶大家走進管理辦公室，從遞退租通知、修正日期、談押金規則，一路聽到交房檢查與轉寄地址，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📝 開場：Hi, um, I'm giving notice? Moving out, kinda.
🧾 書面規定：It can, but I need it in writing.
💰 押金真相：My deposit covers the last month, right?
🔑 歸還清單：Clean unit, no damage, all keys returned.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、honestly 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著搬一次家，下次你站在那個櫃台前，條件和問題都會自己開口問。

祝你退租順利，押金足額退回。
